title: Bảng giá vé chữ nổi Đường sắt Đô thị Thành Phố Hồ Chí Minh
legal_basis: Photo released under CC0 on Wikimedia Commons, so it can be reused without restriction.
notes: Wall-mounted metro fare board listing stations against single, monthly and direct-sale fares, with Braille printed under the Vietnamese text.

title: Giờ mở cửa, đình Bích Câu Đạo Quán, Hà Nội
legal_basis: Photo of a public opening-hours notice posted on a temple door, uploaded to Wikimedia Commons under CC BY-SA 4.0.
notes: Red and yellow temple notice with winter, summer and holiday opening hours laid out as label and time columns.

title: Sữa Chua Trân Châu Houjicha shop menu boards, Nam Định
legal_basis: Photo of public menu boards in a shop front, uploaded to Wikimedia Commons under CC BY-SA 4.0.
notes: Wall-mounted menu panels with yogurt and topping product names and VND prices in two columns; the text is small and the photo is low resolution.

title: Vinpearland price list (Bảng giá / Price list)
legal_basis: Photo of a ticket price notice displayed at a public ticket point, uploaded to Wikimedia Commons under CC BY 2.0.
notes: Bilingual Vietnamese and English ticket price poster with package names and VND prices in rows, photographed through a glass window with glare.

title: Vietnam North-South Railway Timetable (effective from 26-01-2024 to 26-02-2024)
legal_basis: Photo of a public railway timetable board at a station, uploaded to Wikimedia Commons under CC BY-SA 4.0.
notes: Printed BẢNG GIỜ TÀU board with a dense ruled grid of stations against train departure times for Sài Gòn–Hà Nội services, in Vietnamese.

title: Quy Nhơn Vinh train timetable (BẢNG GIỜ TÀU)
legal_basis: Photo of a public train timetable board at a station, uploaded to Wikimedia Commons under CC BY-SA 3.0.
notes: Ruled BẢNG GIỜ TÀU board for Quy Nhơn–Vinh trains with station rows, distances, departure times and passenger and luggage fare columns; figures appear hand-filled in blue ink.

title: Phan Thiết bus station fare and departure notice (BẢNG NIÊM YẾT GIÁ VÉ VÀ GIỜ XUẤT BẾN)
legal_basis: Photo of an official fare and departure notice posted at a public bus station, released under CC0 on Wikimedia Commons.
notes: Printed sheet at the Phan Thiết bus station listing routes, operators, departure times and VND fares in a ruled table, with both inter-provincial and local sections.

title: Việt Hàn Bus Station Schedule (BẢNG GIỜ XE)
legal_basis: Photo of a public bus departure schedule board at a bus station, released under CC0 on Wikimedia Commons.
notes: Green BẢNG GIỜ XE board at the Việt Hàn bus station with route names and departure times in a ruled grid, in Vietnamese.
